grc:verb:ὑπέμενον.gloss: first-person singular/third-person plural imperfect active indicative of ὑπομένω (hupoménō)

grc:verb:ὑπεμνήμυκε.html:
ὑπεμνήμυκε, in , πάντα δ' ὑπεμνήμυκε, of an orphan boy: interpreted it—
he hangs down his head utterly, he is altogether cast down; so that it must be taken (cf. Sch.) as Ep.pf. of ὑπ-ημύω, for ὑπ-εμήμυκε (ν being inserted metri gr.):—the pres. is used by coluth., ὑπημύουσι παρειαίsink in, become hollow.
